author: val
body: A reason is stored as the bytes the keyboard speaks rather than as CCE, for the reason the console's line is: they arrive through `apply-mods` and leave through `from-unicode`, and reading them as CCE renders every letter as the wrong glyph.

author: val
body: The comma is asked of the encoding rather than written down: CCE is not ASCII, so a literal code point here would name a different character.
